item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena presses a rubber sucker hook onto a smooth steel almirah in her kitchen, and it stays firmly in place. Her brother says it sticks because rubber is naturally sticky. Meena says air pressure is responsible.
Which statement correctly explains why the sucker sticks?

options.A: The rubber surface is sticky, so it grips the steel; air pressure plays no role.
options.B: Pressing the sucker pushes air out, so the higher atmospheric pressure outside presses it against the steel.
options.C: Air pressure inside the sucker increases and pushes it onto the steel.
options.D: The steel almirah attracts the rubber sucker like a magnet attracts iron.
